title: Sealed needle-in-tube device moves 3-4 feet

tellings.quote: tube. Then I cranked up my power supply and that thing moved 3 4 feet in the air.

plain: A guest named Charles Buhler says that in 2016, in his lab, a device made of a needle sealed inside a tube rose three to four feet into the air when he turned up his power supply. He tells it first-hand on the show, mentioning a colleague named Andrew Arjima and videos posted on a website called Exodus, as evidence of a push that works without any fuel or moving parts.
